comment: Recognition layer-2 community signs. Each community triggers a name sign (HUD popup) as the player drives through. lat/lon in WGS84; radius in compressed world-units (~300 per real km). 'needs_owner_review': true marks entries where owner's lived knowledge should override research data.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The airport peninsula — sea on both sides, coconut trees lining the road.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Community at the end of Palisadoes, just before the roundabout onto Windward Road.

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial and residential area on Windward Road heading into Kingston.

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital city — downtown waterfront, Coronation Market, National Heroes Park.

communities.name: Liguanea
communities.note: Uptown residential area near New Kingston — Sovereign Centre nearby.

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Kingston's main commercial hub — the famous clock tower stands at the crossroads.

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former colonial capital of Jamaica — the Cathedral, Rodney Memorial, White Marl.

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: Historic single-lane bridge over the Rio Cobre at the mouth of Bog Walk gorge.

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Community in the dramatic gorge — Rio Cobre river runs alongside the road.

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Alumina plant town between Bog Walk and Linstead.

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town — home of the folk song 'Carry Me Ackee Go A Linstead Market'.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Mountain junction town — Moneague College, cool highland air.

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshop row — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival, water coconut.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Bamboo-canopied gorge carved through the mountains — one of Jamaica's iconic drives.

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourist hub on the north coast — Dunn's River Falls, cruise ship port.
